B2.label: model payload validated as JSON before reserving; nested diagnostic paths scrubbed

sender.defect: structuredClone was the only admission test; it clones a BigInt and a NaN without complaint and silently drops symbol keys, so all three could reserve budget and then fail to serialise or deliver a different request than the one admitted
sender.fix: the input is checked as the structured JSON a provider would receive before any admission, reservation or transport work; a nested bigint, non-finite number, symbol key or cycle refuses and names the offending path

diagnostics.defect: private paths still escaped through caller-supplied capability detail/invalidation, the model-identity provenance note, and raw CLI version output (which printed the executed path)
diagnostics.fix: one helper masks absolute, drive-letter and home-relative paths in every public string; full text stays behind includePrivate

realPath: real child Runner fed over the frozen frame protocol
answer_question delivered to the original native request
B1.sigkillWindow: the coordinator dies by SIGKILL with the question durable; a fresh process keeps work/ticket/question/fact rows and appends no new fact or dispatch

the effect table IS the durable queue, so it drains on completion; it is asserted from the peak observed while work was pending
a fresh process legitimately reports no LIVE question via inspect(); the durable claim is about store rows and absence of re-execution, not in-memory rehydration
